audit.why: EVEN / 5.5-10 matches the 52.84% win rate over 5087 games. Galio holds levels 1-5 on tempo and MR, Sylas takes over at 6 once Hijack can take Hero's Entrance. Side lane and teamfights favour Galio's peel; snowball favours Sylas.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes credited Sylas's sustain to his Q ('Q chain sustain', 'Q lifesteal'). Chain Lash (Q) only damages and slows; the heal is Kingslayer (W).
audit.why: enemyKit: Q = Chain Lash, slow flag only. W = Kingslayer, heal flag, 12/10.5/9/7.5/6s. Attributing the heal to the wrong ability makes the anti-heal and cooldown advice unusable.
audit.corrected: Spikes now name Kingslayer (W) and its 12s->6s cooldown; Hijack (R) 80/55/30 named at the level 6 spike.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never states the decisive interaction: Hijack is a 950-range targeted steal, so where Galio casts Hero's Entrance decides the fight. Abscond/Abduct cooldown was written as 'fifteen-second' with no source.
audit.why: Sylas E is 13/12/11/10/9 and R range is 950. Galio R range is 4000/4750/5500 — he can cast from outside Hijack range. That is the matchup's real lever and it was absent.
audit.corrected: Abduct (E) stated at 13s rank 1 / 9s maxed; Hijack stated at 950 units and 80s rank 1; don't-list now warns against casting R inside that range.

audit.why: It is the field that holds real cooldowns.
missingInteractions flags needs-antiheal for Kingslayer (W). report[8] already says to add anti-heal early; breakdown.feeding now names Oblivion Orb explicitly.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were the tradeGood/tradeBad strings pasted under unrelated titles (lintFindings COPY_PASTE_BLEED).
audit.why: Title promises one thing, body explains another.
audit.corrected: Both bodies replaced with content matching their titles.

edits.before: - Sylas Abscond / Abduct: matchup-defining — Dash into chain-stun — punish him hard while it is down. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget W Shield of Durand for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Abduct (E) is 13s at rank 1 and 9s maxed — the dash-and-pull is his only gap-close, so step up only on its downtime. - Kingslayer (W) heals him off you every 12s early; Hijack (R) is 80s at rank 1, so a wasted steal is a long window.

edits.before: Q the contact, let the tornado tick, E-auto if he answers, W-taunt the commit — a full rotation where his half landed on a shield.
edits.after: Abscond (E) leaves him mid-dash — Winds of War on the landing spot ticks him for the full duration while Abduct is on its 13s recast.

edits.before: Sylas burns Abscond / Abduct on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Sylas burns Abduct (E) on nothing — take the thirteen-second invitation.

edits.before: That’s Sylas’s bread-and-butter play — deny it and they run out of answers.
edits.after: He feints with Abscond (E) and recasts Abduct only if you commit — hold it.

edits.before: Trade AD lethality spikes at even HP
edits.after: Cast R with Sylas inside 950 units

edits.before: Your R locks you in place mid-channel — casting it without the wave parked is donating two waves and a tower.
edits.after: Hijack reaches 950 units — cast where he can take it and his next fight opens with your own knock-up engage.

edits.before: Charging W through a minion line at a mage holding his answer — the statue mid-charge is the lane's easiest skillshot target.
edits.after: Justice Punch is your only exit at 11s rank 1; leave without it and Abduct (E) pulls you back into a wave you already gave him.

edits.before: Sylas wins by landing Abscond / Abduct, denying your pattern, and cashing the all-in before your pattern matures.
edits.after: Sylas wins by stealing Hero's Entrance with Hijack and opening the fight with your own knock-up before your shield matters.

edits.before: Ahead, tax both maps: zone Sylas with taunt threat, keep the wave middle, and R every skirmish — fed Galio makes the enemy jungler unemployed.
edits.after: Ahead, deny the steal: keep the wave middle, zone him off with taunt threat, and spend Hero's Entrance where his 950-range Hijack cannot follow.

edits.before: If Sylas opens the score, reset expectations and respect Abscond / Abduct doubly. After a second, your job description changes — farm with Q clears and stay relevant through taunt peel and R arrivals.
edits.after: If Sylas opens the score, buy Oblivion Orb — Kingslayer (W) heals him out of every trade you start. Farm with Winds of War clears and stay relevant through taunt peel and Hero's Entrance arrivals.

edits.before: Carry through arrivals — Hero's Entrance turns every losing skirmish your team starts into a 5v4 with a knockup.
edits.after: Carry by making Hijack worthless — cast Hero's Entrance from range and land it before his 950-unit steal can reach you.

edits.before: Track Sylas’s Abscond / Abduct: Dash into chain-stun — punish him hard while it is down. It’s down or you don’t go.
edits.after: Abscond (E) dashes; the recast Abduct pulls him to you. Both are one 13s cooldown at rank 1 — down means go, up means hold.

edits.before: Commit on Abscond / Abduct’s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your jungler’s setup. Make him flinch first.
edits.after: Commit while Abduct (E) is down, right after Kingslayer (W) is spent on a minion, and on your first item spike.

edits.before: Level 3-5: your full combo outtrades his Q sustain before he's invested enough points to heal through it, so you're favoured.
edits.after: Level 3-5: your full combo outtrades Kingslayer (W), his only heal, before he has the points to sustain through Winds of War.

edits.before: 2+ items: his Q lifesteal plus stolen-ult burst starts winning extended trades, keeping him ahead through this window.
edits.after: 2+ items: Kingslayer (W) healing plus stolen-ult burst starts winning extended trades, keeping him ahead through this window.

edits.before: Your Justice Punch stun and Winds of War poke outdamage Sylas's Q chain sustain before he has enough ability points invested to fight you head-on.
edits.after: Your Justice Punch knock-up and Winds of War poke outdamage Kingslayer (W) healing before he has the points in it to fight you head-on.

edits.before: Riftmaker/Rocketbelt Sylas heals through your poke via Q lifesteal and his stolen ults start adding real burst, tipping trades in his favor if he's ahead on kills.
edits.after: Riftmaker Sylas heals through your poke with Kingslayer (W) on a 9s cooldown and his stolen ults start adding real burst, tipping trades if he's ahead on kills.

edits.before: Once he's ahead on kills or has stolen a strong ultimate in a fight, his level-6-plus power compounds into the late game — Q lifesteal sustains him through extended trades and a well-timed ult steal (yours included) can swing a teamfight instantly. If you've built a lead by mid-game and avoid feeding him easy ult-steal picks, you can still close the game out, but going in blind post-6 without a lead is risky.
edits.after: Once he's ahead on kills or has stolen a strong ultimate in a fight, his level-6-plus power compounds into the late game — Kingslayer (W) heals him through extended trades every 6s and a well-timed Hijack (yours included) can swing a teamfight instantly. If you've built a lead by mid-game and avoid feeding him easy ult-steal picks, you can still close the game out, but going in blind post-6 without a lead is risky.

edits.before: Punish his sustain-reliant Q poke before it ramps with ability points
edits.after: Punish him while Kingslayer (W) is a 12s heal, before it ramps to 6s

edits.before: Farm and sustain off Q chain healing to survive early trades
edits.after: Farm and sustain off Kingslayer (W) to survive early trades

notes: Level chart left untouched: page and packet.levelChart agree exactly (Galio 1-5, Sylas 6 and 2+ items), so no side/win pair needed changing. Main correction was Sylas's heal being attributed to Chain Lash (Q) across content — it is Kingslayer (W). Whether Hijack can steal Hero's Entrance mid-channel is not in Riot's text; I stated only the 950 range and did not assert the channel interaction.
